items.name: Takeda ENHANZE collaboration and license agreement (ENTYVIO/vedolizumab)
items.claim: In December 2025, Halozyme and Takeda entered into a new global collaboration and exclusive license agreement giving Takeda access to ENHANZE for use with vedolizumab (ENTYVIO), for Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis.
items.source_excerpt: In December 2025, Halozyme and Takeda entered into a new global collaboration and exclusive license agreement which provides Takeda with access to ENHANZE ® for use with vedolizumab, marketed globally as ENTYVIO ® , for the treatment of adults with moderately to severely active Crohns' disease or ulcerative colitis, which are the two main forms of inflammatory bowel disease.

items.name: 2026 ENHANZE/Hypercon development pipeline and partnership targets
items.claim: Halozyme's 2026 outlook cites an expanding development pipeline with six projected new ENHANZE and two Hypercon development program starts, plus plans to sign three or more ENHANZE and Hypercon partnerships in 2026.
items.source_excerpt: Our projected 22% to 30% total revenue growth in 2026, combined with an expanding development pipeline with six projected new ENHANZE and two Hypercon development program starts, plus plans to sign three or more ENHANZE and Hypercon partnerships in 2026, all reinforce the durability of our revenue.
